method: Unofficial fan-poll log (owner decision 2026-09-20, superseding the 2026-09-18 track-only policy): scraped weekly by src/scrape_polls.py as a run_weekly.py stage, plus hand-logged rows (FB groups, transcribed result images — marked auto_scraped:false). Sources are self-selected fan-war polls (e.g. bbnaijadaily.com widget allows up to 100 votes/person), so numbers measure vote-war intensity, not electorate share. Full-share sources (live widget + manual rows) feed a WEAK poll-anchored prior (median normalized share -> alpha-column location shift 0.25*clip(log(s_i*n), ±log 4)); rank-only sources (ngnews247 video titles) and backfilled FINAL snapshots are concordance/review-only and never anchor the prior. All snapshots are archived per week under data/raw/week_XX/.

concordance_definitions.hazard_concordance: Share of housemate pairs where poll save-% rank order agrees with the model's Cox relative-hazard rank order (lower hazard = safer). 0.5 = coin flip.
concordance_definitions.winner_top3: Poll leader set vs the model's p_rank_1 top-3. Known structural gap: blog coverage (CPI) ≠ vote intensity — quiet fanbases (Keivo, Ricky) poll high while high-coverage housemates (Chimsom Chuka) can poll low with anti-vote drag.

weeks.source: bbnaijadaily.com/bbnaija-voting-polls (week-8 vote-to-save widget, ~621k total votes, repeat-votable)

model_at_snapshot.note: docs/predictions.json generated 2026-09-17; contains the week-8 DM remainder-bin bug (last active column Yusuf hard-zeroed) fixed in notebooks/bbnaija_mcmc.py on 2026-09-18 — numbers below are pre-fix and Yusuf's p_rank_1=0.0 is a known artifact.

weeks.notes: Poll #1 (Keivo) == model's safest nominated (hazard 0.69); poll #11 (Chimsom Chuka) == model's most at-risk (1.82). Winner-model disagreement is the documented coverage-vs-vote-intensity gap. Sunday eviction outcome to be scored into docs/track_record.json.
